Renal Physiology Notes

The glomerular filtration rate is the volume of plasma filtered by the glomeruli each minute, normally close to one hundred and twenty millilitres in a healthy adult.

The proximal convoluted tubule reabsorbs roughly two thirds of the filtered sodium and water, along with almost all of the filtered glucose and amino acids.
